intro: Curing the Sick is an essential trial for young Horde druids, tasking them with healing afflicted wildlife in the northern Barrens. By applying a freshly concocted herbal salve to ailing gazelles, initiates demonstrate both their practical field medicine and their commitment to preserving natural balance. Completing this duty proves their dedication directly to the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I was able to make enough salve for ten doses of curing, friend. While I work with local authorities to try and make some more salve, I'd like for you to help us get a head start. All around the northern Barrens are sickly gazelles; use the salve on them and cure their malaise.

Dendrite Starblaze in Moonglade will want to talk to you when you're done, I'm sure. Please extend our thanks to the Cenarion Circle there... And let me say thanks to you directly for the help you've given!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you completed what was asked of you by Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads? Your work is not complete unless it is.

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done well in tending to the sickly gazelles of the Barrens; they are unwitting victims of a greater taint and corruption that is spreading all throughout the land. You tauren are most eager to understand the ways of Cenarius; you, like your elders in Thunder Bluff, are proving that the need for balance transcends artificial racial barriers.
Friend, you've proven your worth as an friend of nature and the Circle - take this as a symbol of such.
